crossRefs.note: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have…
In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

translations.web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.
translations.bsb: I would give account of all my steps; I would approach Him like a prince.)—
